summary: Rewrote the reader-facing console pages for the baselines-diagnostics and constructive-reservoir families: both family README.mdx pages plus the fourteen approach pages (d4-flow, heuristic-benchmark, native-parity, phase-benchmark, throughput-probe, tie-breaking, trajectory-throughput; constructive-spectrum, panel-value, rise-option-qd, structural-terminal-veto, tail-survival-cem, vertical-reservoir, viability-controller). Each page follows the four-altitude template, quotes only figures that exist in a retained record with its source and evidence label, states 'no retained result' where the ledger has none, and marks diagnostics and the privileged trajectory-throughput arm as such. Three figures were generated with the TypeScript rules engine (a reservoir released by a row rise, a clear/reveal flow move, and a mirror-symmetric tie); no research record, protocol or source file was modified and no gameplay run was performed.
validationPerformed: node web/scripts/check-mdx.mjs passes for the written pages
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
